description: Move a message to another folder: archive, trash, junk, inbox, or a named folder.

account.description: Which connected mailbox to use (its label from mailroom_accounts). Optional when only one is connected or a default is saved in memory.

folder.description: Folder: inbox (default), sent, drafts, trash, junk, archive, all, or a folder name.

id.description: Message id from mailroom_search (a numeric uid for Gmail/IMAP, a Graph id for Microsoft 365).

to_folder.description: Destination: archive, trash, junk, inbox, or a folder name.

name: mailroom_move
